name: Paint Bucket
description: A box full of marbles marked with a paint bucket. Tap it and its marbles pour out — the moment they splash down onto the belt, a burst of paint recolors 3 other boxes to the bucket's OWN color, and flips their matching customers to match too, so the level stays balanced.
howToPlay: Tap the paint bucket in the middle to pour its marbles. Watch the splash when they land: 3 other boxes flip to the bucket's color, and their matching order slots at the bottom flip with them. Then keep sorting as usual to clear every order.
author: Claude
